identity.description: An attacker executes a rare binary that connects to a rare cloud resource, triggering a Cortex alert for unusual network behavior. The attack chain includes downloading a malicious binary, executing it, and establishing a C2 connection to a test-net IP.

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to a rare cloud resource

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Binary Connected to Rare Cloud Resource
biocs.description: Detection of a rare binary (based on file hash) connecting to a rare cloud resource (based on IP reputation)
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "/tmp/scratch/malware"
| filter action_remote_ip = "192.0.2.10"
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from cloud_ip_reputation where is_rare = true)
| filter action_process_image_name in (select file_hash from rare_binary_list where is_rare = true)

abiocs.name: Rare Binary to Rare Cloud Resource Connection
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a rare binary connects to a rare cloud resource, indicating potential C2 communication
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = "192.0.2.10"
| filter action_process_image_name in (select file_hash from rare_binary_list where is_rare = true)
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from cloud_ip_reputation where is_rare = true)

xql_queries.name: Rare Binary to Rare Cloud Resource Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from cloud_ip_reputation where is_rare = true)
| filter action_process_image_name in (select file_hash from rare_binary_list where is_rare = true)
| filter action_remote_ip = "192.0.2.10"
